blocks.text: Tiny garden roots follow the map’s paths and cling like living contour lines.
Location: The Garden Inside the Map
Appearance: Living contour paths grow across the body, with tiny leaf marks appearing along their routes.
Care: Use the parasite treatment listed in Care; cleaning supports recovery but does not replace treatment.
Story connection: A gardener could read the growth to find a path omitted from the map.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed; independent of the story archive.
